html:
Greetings, Agents!

 

CM Fragment reporting in.  

 

MARVEL Future Fight’s May update is now here!


This time, it will be a mutant-centric update which focuses on the X-Men’s [Uncanny X-Men] story.
Various in-game content has been improved, and new X-Men characters have been added!

 

Watch how the X-Men have improved through various training and support by their colleagues!
Iceman, Jubilee, and Bishop will now be joining us in MARVEL Future Fight. That’s 3 new characters added!
We’re also adding 4 new uniforms to support our current X-Men roster!
6 more characters can now awaken their inner potential! Make sure to strengthen the X-Men once the update lands.
The Phoenix Force has been successfully mastered by Jean Grey! Tier-3 for Jean Grey has been unlocked. 

 

Various in-game content where our all-new and enhanced X-Men can unleash their skills has been improved. 
For those Agents who will challenge Shadowland for the first time! Shadowland first clear rewards have been added.
We’ve also added a Uniform Ranking and Favorites feature where agents can check stats regarding the uniform or save the uniform as a part of their wishlist. 
For your convenience, small changes have been made to World Event, Agent Level, World Boss Invasion, etc. 
We have optimized and improved a variety of content! Check below for more details regarding the update.
 

▣ 3 Characters Added!

 

Iceman, who manipulates ice to freeze enemies, Jubilee, who creates colorful fireworks, and Bishop, a mutant who came from the future and can absorb energy, have been added in-game.

 

 

 

 

 

▣ 4 Uniforms Added!

 

Enhance the X-Men! Four new [X-Men Disassembled] themed uniforms has been added. 
Meet Jean Grey / Beast / Storm / Psylocke’s new uniforms!

 

 

* The Skill descriptions shown above are at Skill Level 1.
* 4 new uniforms will be on sale during the event period. You can check them out on the Marvel Universe menu and by going to the Uniform Room.
 

▣ 6 More Potential Awakened Characters

 

This May update will allow you to realize the potential of the characters below: Iceman / Jubilee / Bishop / Storm / Jean Grey / Beast. 
You can now raise them up to Level 70.

 

 

▣ New Tier-3 Upgrade for Jean Grey

 

The chosen one by the Phoenix Force: Jean Grey! Watch her as she takes control of this power completely by unlocking her Tier-3!

 

Her new flames will definitely make her enemies cower in fear. 

 

 

 

 

▣ Added Shadowland’s First Clear Rewards 

 

Rewards are now available for agents who have proven their skills in defeating countless villains in Shadowland.
You can now receive rewards upon clearing the 31st floor, and above, of Shadowland for the first time. 

 

 

- Rewards are now available on our Infinity floors mode. 
- The first clear rewards can be claimed once and will be sent directly to your Inbox.
- You can claim the first clear reward from the cleared floor after the update.
- If you cleared the floors before the update, you can still receive the first clear reward by re-entering a floor to initialize the rewards.

 

[Shadowland First Clear Rewards]
 

- Earn special rewards every 5th floor cleared together with a Shadowland Chest between each floor!
Ex.: The first clear reward on the 31st to 34th floor will be the Shadowland Chest
 

▣ New Uniform Ranking and Favorites feature added!

 

There are a lot of uniforms designed to enhance characters with different effects. Not sure what to buy? You can now create your own wishlist by using the Uniform Ranking and Favorite functions!


Have you ever wondered, which uniforms other agents purchase and enhanced? You can now check that using our new Uniform Ranking system!

 

- Uniform ranks are based on the number of purchases/number of times the uniform was enhanced. 

 

Another new feature has also been added, a Favorite feature that you can use to mark uniforms that you like, and make it easier to purchase them through your personalized list or by purchasing them in bulk!

 

- Personalized your own list of uniforms that you wish to purchase by using ON/OFF function as shown above.

 

You can view and purchase your personalized favorite list of uniforms, you set, with one button!

 

 

▣ New Dimension Rift: [Mutant from the Future] Bishop

 

The X-Men Police X.S.E Member, Bishop, has recently joined MARVEL Future Fight. 
Find out the purpose of his recent arrival in the new Dimension Rift!

 

You can earn Bishop’s X-Genes as rewards together with some Comic Cards through the “Mutant from the Future” Dimension Rift.

 

 

Clearing “Mutant from the Future” Dimension Rift gives you a chance of obtaining a new Comic Card.

 

[UNCANNY X-MEN (2018) #8]

 

- Fixed options include All Attack Increase.
- Random options include ignore defense, reduce cooldown duration and various other effects!
 

▣ Added New Beast Support Chest

 

Added a new Support Chest to help speed up the growth of your X-Men characters.
This product will be sold in the Store until further notice, but can only be purchased once per account.

 

Purchase the Beast Support Chest and receive 200 Crystals immediately.

You can also acquire a variety of X-Men growth materials, such as, a 6★ Mega Rank Up Ticket and many more randomly, test your luck daily by logging in for 7 days. 

The items from the Beast Support Chest will be sent to you daily once purchased.

 

[Beast Support Chest]

 

* You can still receive all 7 Beast Support Chests even if you do not log in for consecutive days. 

 

[Beast Support Chest Contents and Probability List]

 

* There is no Sales Period for the Beast Support Chest. This item has a limited number of purchases and can only be purchased once per account.
* Price is based on the Google Play Store.
* You can get one of the items listed above through the Beast Support Chest.

 

 

▣ New Product Iceman Package
 

Introducing the new package to be released together with the X-Men character, Iceman. 
This package can be purchased from the [Store] > [Acquire / Upgrade Characters] > [Acquire Character] tab > Iceman.

 

The package will be available until further notice.

 

Get a 6★ Iceman and some Gold instantly on your first purchase. You can acquire his X-Genes and upgrade materials on your succeeding purchases.

 

*The second and succeeding Iceman Package purchases have no limits, until further notice.
*The Iceman Package will be available for purchase until further notice.

 

4. New Uniform Collection <Disassembled> Added

 

New Uniform Collection added [Disassembled]. Complete the specified conditions and receive special rewards while enjoying your character's new looks.

 

 

▣ Other Game Improvements

 

1. The functions for the in-game contents mentioned below have been improved for each agent’s convenience. 
 

[World Event]
① A “Participation is available” message will be displayed in the World Event main screen.

 

- If there are remaining entries or is already participating, it will be marked as “Available Now”.

 

② The character information screen pop-up has been improved.

 

-Some UI changes for ease of navigation.

 

- Improved to display Team Effect names for selected team.

 

③After the battle is over, the result window will clearly show your achievements and your next goal.

 

 

④ The session information of the Agent who reached MVP is presented in a more detailed form.

 

 

[World Boss Invasion]

 

① World Boss Invasion has been improved to allow users to reconnect whenever your session ends because of an error, you will be able to play again using the characters you have selected.  

 

② You can now skip the opening cinematic of World Boss Invasion Supply Chest opening. 

 

 

 

[Agent Level]


① You can now purchase Agent Tokens if you have insufficient Agent tokens to raise your Agent Badge level.

 

 

② You can now check more information regarding the items you can use to enhance your Agent Badge. 

 

- You can do this by touching the “?” icon. 

 

③ Agent Token and Kit location screen has been improved, it is now more convenient to go to the World Event or Agent Badge window.

 

 

 

 

[Other Content]

 

① You can now check the progress of each Epic Quest’s Collection before entering.  

 

 

② Upon receiving the final compensation for any Quest Pack in Special Missions mode, the Quest Pack button will be deactivated.  

 

 

③ An improvement with 20 Biometrics Daily, upon selecting and acquiring biometrics, the last one you picked will automatically be moved to the front of the list. 

 

 

④ We have improved equipped Urus on the Character Gear screen. you can now see if the Urus are amplified or not.  

 

 

⑤ An All Accept / Reject All / Send All friend request buttons have been added on the Friends screen. 

 

 

2. In Tutorial mode, Thor’s model has been changed. 

 

 

3.  More Missions have been added in our S.H.I.E.L.D. Academy mode. We have also improved the UI for ease of use. 
① Shortcuts have been added to make it easier to complete missions. 

 

- Resizing and repositioning have been done to make tasks and rewards easier to see!

 

② All new Academy missions have been added.


[ List of New Academy Missions]
 

 - Academy Missions regarding, equipping ISO-8, Comic Card enhancement, and Special Gear enhancement have been changed.
 - Additional rewards have also been added with the new Academy Missions.

 

4. Difficulty of Villain in Special Mission Stage 1 has been adjusted. 

 

5. New Daily Trivia Quizzes have been added. 

 

6. Added the ability to sort Friends and Alliance Members by Agent Level.

 

▣ Other Improvements

 

1. Fixed an issue when using the “Death Portal” skill of Thanos [Avengers: Infinity War] and [Avengers: Endgame] uniform to shoot to the sky when the opponents are not nearby.


2. Improved the slash animation of Thanos [Avengers: Endgame] uniform when performing the “Warlord Slash” towards the opponent.


3. The model of Nebula [Avengers: Endgame] and [Team Suit] have been modified to reflect the movie more accurately. 


4. The skill animation has been fixed for Quasar(Avril Kincaid) [All-New, All Different] when using ‘Energy Stream’, the skill animation was showing abnormally.

 

5. Fixed the issue where Uniform Enhancement materials for Captain Marvel MARVEL'S AVENGERS: Endgame, Thor MARVEL'S AVENGERS: ENDGAME, and Thor Team Suit are priced the same as 1,250 Crystal priced uniforms. [Added on 5/29 1:45 AM (UTC+0) l 5/28 6:45 PM (PDT) ]

 

6. A MARVEL'S Avengers: Endgame logo is displayed when previewing Avengers: Endgame and Team Suit uniforms. [Added 5/29 7:00 AM (UTC+0) | 12:00 AM (PDT)]

 

MARVEL Future Fight’s May update draws near with new characters and content. We hope you enjoy the contents that we have prepared for everyone including some to improve the overall experience of the game. 

Second, the Endgame update is not yet over.


Additional updates and contents, including “Skill” improvements are being prepared and Improvements include, but are not limited to, character skill modifications coming in mid-July.
 

This will be all for now, I’ll definitely be back with more details once they are ready. 

 

Thank you.
 

*Disclaimer: All screenshots and images were taken from a test server, and may vary from released details.
